title: zarr-spectral-schema spec DSL meta-schema
description: Validates spec/schema.yaml itself. The DSL is fully declarative so the validator can stay a generic interpreter; this meta-schema is the guard that keeps the spec well-formed. Self-validating: schema.yaml conforms to this, and this is itself a valid JSON Schema (draft 2020-12).

spec_version.description: This repo's package version (off-disk; provenance only).

versions.description: Producer-owned, on-disk version attributes, keyed by the on-disk attribute name.

levels.description: Structural contract per data level (L0, L1, ...).

lists.description: Ordered name lists → `pub const NAME: &[&str]`. Key = the Rust const identifier.

markers.description: Single attribute-name constants → `pub const NAME: &str`. Key = the Rust const identifier.

precedence_aliases.description: Validator-only spec data (generates NO const): for each canonical attribute (the key), the ordered source-keyword precedence chain it may be resolved from. Documents resolution provenance; the generic validator does not enforce it.

version_value.description: An on-disk version: major or major.minor, ASCII digits only (the grammar both bindings parse).

on_disk.description: How the value is encoded in the store attribute.

const.description: Override the generated Rust const identifier (default UPPER(attr key)).

detect.description: Root attribute whose presence marks a store as this level (e.g. l0_schema_version).

one_of.description: Groups of which each placement target holds exactly one. Only the present group's arrays are checked; both or neither is an error.

const.description: Override the generated group const identifier (default UPPER(name)_GROUP), or `false` to emit none.

placement.description: Where this group's arrays live relative to a scan group. `scan`: under scan_<N>; `scan_or_band`: under scan_<N> (single-frontend) or each band_<M> (multi-frontend).

inline.description: true ⇒ arrays sit directly in the target dir (no sub-group path segment); false ⇒ under <target>/<groupname>/.

attrs.description: On-disk attribute declarations for one placement level. Generate NO consts; validator data only.

type.description: JSON value type the attribute is encoded as.

equals.description: Value constraint: when present on disk, the attribute must hold exactly this value.

format.description: String format constraint, allowed on a `type: string` attr only. `uri-reference`: an RFC 3986 URI reference (an absolute URI, or a relative reference resolved against the URI of the store), never empty and never an absolute path.

dtype.description: Zarr v3 data type name (core types + variable-length `string`), or a set of names the array may take (e.g. [float64, float32]). Producers write the first name of a set by default.

attrs.description: Attributes of the array itself (e.g. keepbits), checked like group attrs.

prefix.description: Array family: the entry matches every array in the group whose name starts with this prefix (e.g. spectrum_ for spectrum_0, spectrum_1_3). `required` then means at least one member.

const.description: Override the generated array const identifier (default UPPER(on-disk name)).

precedence_alias.description: One canonical attribute's source-keyword precedence chain.

from.description: Source keywords in precedence order (highest first).
